head: e912d6bd9811187491dcdfb7a4cdb72f0e8314ad
summary:
The fix removes O-053 (m3). The only thing I found is one stale sentence in a test corpus's note, filed as a text finding for the comment fixer.

**What changed.** At src/FsAnalyser.Core/CommandLine.cs:99 the exposed-token check is now `quote < 0 && argument == ReportOption`, where it was `StartsWith("--")`. `ReportOption` is a new public const at CommandLine.cs:10, and App.xaml.cs:9 reads it, so the option is spelled in one place. The docstring at :52-57 and the comment at :87-91 were corrected.

**Tests I ran on e912d6b.**
- The given test, tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/CommandLineDashFolderTests.cs, matches the reviewer's test word for word.
- The engine's filter plus UnpairedQuoteCorpusTests and the other CommandLine tests: 39 of 39 pass.
- The bug project passes 8 of 8, including the new exe-level fact. In that fact, `"<tree>\" --report "<work>\out --old\r.json"` exits 0 and writes the report at that exact path.
- The whole suite passes 1451 of 1451.

**The class corpus.** UnpairedQuoteCorpus.json now has rows D01-D12 and R01, plus a dashSweep. The sweep runs each line again with `--old` renamed to `old` and requires the same verdict and the same arguments.

**Trying to break the narrowed check.**
- Every IN-M1 shape has `--report` in it, so narrowing does not reopen it. U01-U09 still pass, and I traced two new strays by hand: `D:\Data\" --report out.json "x` and `D:\Data\" --report out.json" x`. In both, `--report` would be hidden, so the line falls back to Windows' split.
- Lines with no `--report` are still guarded by the trailing-root stem check.
- A report file literally named `--report` (D05) still repairs, because the repair keeps a `--report` token of its own.
- The builder's follow-up is right. A report path piece ending in `\"` is a folder, which the app refuses with exit 3 anyway.
- Nothing else in src or tests still claims that a token starting with `--` is an option.

**The stale note.** UnpairedQuoteCorpus.json's `_note` defines `before` as what the code did without the pairing and exposed-token steps. For the new D rows, `before` instead records the attempt-2 code with `StartsWith("--")`. Under the note's own definition, D01 would read "repaired", not "refused (null)".

**Departures.** The public `CommandLine.ReportOption` const was declared. There is no undeclared drift.

Second round: This pass tried to break the O-053 fix and found nothing new. The fix is one ordinal equality at CommandLine.cs:99 (`argument == ReportOption`) and a const that App.xaml.cs:9 reads.

- **Shapes tried:**
  - `--report` exposed by Windows as a piece of a quoted path. When the typed line also has the real option, the repair keeps a `--report` of its own and the check passes (D05). When it does not, the line is not a report line, and it falls back to null or argv (R01).
  - A dashed piece after a tab-separated line.
  - The trailing stray quotes I traced in round one.
- **The three repair conditions:** the quote-parity, exposed `--report` and trailing-root conditions are unchanged apart from the narrowing. None of them can now refuse a valid report line because a folder name starts with dashes, and the dashSweep holds that across 3,900 lines.
- **The dashSweep test:** it reads its own `dashSweep` block. Only a missing block would make it throw, and that would be a red test, not a false pass.
- **Callers and other paths:** no new boundary, error path or lock is involved. The const is compile-time, and both callers compare ordinally as before.

Round one's text finding m4, the stale `_note` in UnpairedQuoteCorpus.json, stands.

Reading pass: Nothing new in CommandLineDashFolderTests.cs (lines 1-21, read in full). The file is my earlier repro exactly as I wrote it.

It feeds two lines, `"D:\Data\" --report "C:\out --old\r.json"` and the spaced-root version `"D:\My Data\" --report "C:\Reports --2024\r.json"`. For each it checks that Windows' split leaves a quote inside an argument, then that CommandLine.Arguments returns exactly [root, --report, report].

It failed with null on cc22a1e and passes 2 of 2 on e912d6b. Round one's text finding m4 stands.

findings.claim: The corpus `_note` defines each row's 'before' as what the code did without the pairing and exposed-token steps. The new D rows (lines 23-35) use 'before' for something else: the attempt-2 code, which had those steps but tested `StartsWith("--")`. Under the note's own definition, D01-D04 and D06-D08 would read 'repaired', because the code without those steps repaired them. They say 'refused (null)', so a reader of the corpus misreads what the D rows' 'before' column measured.
findings.evidence: UnpairedQuoteCorpus.json:2 (the `_note`) against D01 at line 23, `"before": "refused (null): the piece '--old\\r.json' was taken for an option the repair hid"`. The pre-pairing code (f42a20b) returned the repair for D01; my first review measured this line repaired on f42a20b and null on cc22a1e.
findings.fix: In the `_note`, say that U rows' 'before' is the code without the pairing and exposed-token steps, and that D and R rows' 'before' is the attempt-2 code whose exposed-option test was `StartsWith("--")` (O-053). Alternatively, give the D rows a field name of their own.

quote.text: 'before' says what the code did without the pairing and exposed-token steps, kept so that the rows the fix closed stay shown.

obligations.evidence: src/FsAnalyser.Core/CommandLine.cs:99 is `argument == ReportOption`. ReportOption is at :10 and App.xaml.cs:9 reads it. The docstring at :52-57 and the comment at :87-91 match. tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/CommandLineDashFolderTests.cs matches the reviewer's test word for word and passes 2 of 2. The corpus is tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/UnpairedQuoteCorpus.json (D01-D12, R01, dashSweep), run by UnpairedQuoteCorpusTests.ADashedNameIsNeverTheReasonForADifferentVerdict, which passes.
The bug project passes 8 of 8 on e912d6b (my run).
CommandLine.cs:78-113. CommandLineUnpairedQuoteTests and U01-U09 still pass after the narrowing, because every member involves --report, which the check still holds.
ReportFile.cs Probe is unchanged since cc22a1e; ReportFileDropFolderTests passes in the 1451-test suite.

cases.evidence: CommandLineTests' merged-line rows still pass in the 39-test filter.
The spaced pair passes at unit level (CommandLineTests and Q04) and at the exe (QuotedRootShapesTests); the new D02 adds a spaced root with a dashed report folder.
tests/bugs/.../QuotedRootShapesTests.cs: the spaced fact plus the new AReportFolderWhoseNameStartsWithTwoDashesAfterASpaceIsTakenWhole feed spaced report folders to the exe; 8 of 8 pass.
